biotools.summary: The Next-Generation (NG) IEDB Tools website provides a redesigned interface for epitope prediction and analysis algorithms, consolidating HLA class I epitope tools and enabling data pipeline building.  It provides access to tools for MHC binding, elution, immunogenicity, processing, epitope clustering, and PEPMatch.
